title: Nutty Molten French Mushroom Gratin
description: A rich and indulgent French dish featuring sauteed mushrooms, creme fraiche, and a nutty flavor profile, this gratin is perfect for a special occasion. It is also ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, making it a great option for those looking for a balancing meal.
instructions: Saute the mushrooms and onions in butter until they are softened.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate bowl, mix together the creme fraiche, gruyere cheese, walnuts, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Combine the mushroom mixture and the creme fraiche mixture in a baking dish.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the gratin hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
